issues.on_page: 18 disbursement lines sum to 174,810.89; Total Disbursements prints 189,138.55
issues.issue: Confirmed a report error, not an extraction miss. All 18 printed Exhibit H disbursement lines are in detail[12..29] and each one matches the page. No other line is printed on p10. A single misread digit can't explain the gap: 14,327.66 isn't one digit times a power of ten. The printed total does agree with Exhibit D (General government 188,929.18 + Park 209.37, p5), Exhibit G (p9) and the fund roll-forward (81,693.95 + 169,355.93 - 189,138.55 = 61,911.33). So the auditor's object schedule leaves out about 14,327.66 of General Fund spending (possibly an unprinted line such as benefits/retirement). General government by object is understated by that much; the statement-level disbursements are correct.
Keno fund spending is all 'State taxes' (p11), i.e. state keno tax remitted. 'other' with review is defensible, but general government would also fit.
This is keno tax paid to the state, not a tax refund or treasurer fee. It could be grants/payments to other entities or miscellaneous expenditure. Judgment call.
This is sales tax remitted on utility sales, not a tax refund or treasurer fee. Judgment call.
